guides.title: Pour-Over (V60)
guides.description: Master the V60 for a clean, nuanced cup that highlights a coffee's unique flavors.

steps.title: Preparation
steps.instruction: Boil water to 205°F (96°C). Weigh 20g of coffee and grind it to a medium-fine consistency, like table salt.

steps.title: Rinse Filter
steps.instruction: Place the V60 on your mug, insert the paper filter, and rinse it thoroughly with hot water. This removes paper taste and preheats the brewer. Discard the rinse water.

steps.title: Bloom
steps.instruction: Add your ground coffee to the filter. Start a timer and pour 40g of water evenly over the grounds. Let it "bloom" for 30-45 seconds to release CO2.

steps.title: Main Pour
steps.instruction: Pour the remaining water in slow, controlled circles, keeping the water level consistent. Aim to finish pouring a total of 320g of water by the 2:30 mark.

steps.title: Drawdown
steps.instruction: Allow all the water to filter through the coffee. The total brew time should be around 3 to 3:30 minutes. Remove the brewer and enjoy.

guides.title: French Press
guides.description: Achieve a full-bodied, rich brew with this classic immersion method.

steps.title: Preparation
steps.instruction: Bring water to a boil and let it cool for 30 seconds (around 200°F/93°C). Weigh 30g of coffee and grind it to a coarse consistency, like breadcrumbs.

steps.title: Add Coffee & Water
steps.instruction: Add the ground coffee to your French press. Start a timer and add 500g of hot water, ensuring all grounds are saturated.

steps.title: Steep
steps.instruction: Place the plunger on top, but do not press down yet. Let the coffee steep for 4 minutes.

steps.title: Plunge
steps.instruction: After 4 minutes, gently and slowly press the plunger all the way down. This separates the grounds from the brewed coffee.

steps.title: Serve
steps.instruction: Pour the coffee into your mug immediately to prevent over-extraction. Serve and enjoy the rich, full-bodied flavor.

guides.title: AeroPress
guides.description: A versatile and fast brewer, perfect for a single, clean, and flavorful cup.

steps.title: Preparation
steps.instruction: Boil water to 185°F (85°C). Weigh 15g of coffee and grind it to a fine, drip-like consistency. Assemble your AeroPress in the standard orientation with a rinsed filter in the cap.

steps.title: Add Coffee & Water
steps.instruction: Place the AeroPress on a sturdy mug. Add your ground coffee. Start a timer and add 220g of water, ensuring all grounds are wet.

steps.title: Stir & Steep
steps.instruction: Gently stir the grounds for about 10 seconds. Insert the plunger to create a vacuum and prevent dripping. Let it steep until the timer reads 1:30.

steps.title: Press
steps.instruction: Remove the plunger slightly, then press down gently and consistently. Stop when you hear a hissing sound. This should take about 30 seconds.

steps.title: Dilute & Enjoy
steps.instruction: You now have a coffee concentrate. You can drink it as is, or add hot water to taste (a 1:1 ratio is a good starting point). Enjoy!

guides.title: Cold Brew
guides.description: A smooth, low-acid coffee concentrate, perfect for hot days.

steps.title: Preparation
steps.instruction: You'll need 100g of coffee, ground very coarse. Use a large jar or a dedicated cold brew maker.

steps.title: Combine & Steep
steps.instruction: Combine the 100g of coffee grounds with 800g (800ml) of cold, filtered water in your container. Stir gently to ensure all grounds are wet.

steps.title: Wait
steps.instruction: Cover the container and let it steep at room temperature for 12-18 hours. The longer it steeps, the stronger the concentrate will be.

steps.title: Filter
steps.instruction: After steeping, filter the coffee concentrate to remove the grounds. You can use a fine-mesh sieve lined with cheesecloth, or the filter from your cold brew maker.

steps.title: Serve
steps.instruction: Store your concentrate in the fridge for up to two weeks. To serve, dilute with water or milk (a 1:1 or 1:2 ratio is common) and add ice. Enjoy!
